questions.question: As King David was dying, he told his son Solomon to be strong and to do what else?
Before he died, King David reminded Solomon of a promise the LORD had made to him. What was the promise?

answers.text: A man of his line on Israel's throne
A palace that would never fall
Peace with every nation around him

questions.question: King David told Solomon what to do about Joab, who had killed two army commanders. What should Solomon do?

answers.text: Not let him die in peace

questions.question: King David ruled Israel for forty years, seven of them in Hebron. How many years did he rule in Jerusalem?
